derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and a compound of G1519 (εἰς) and G1416 (δύνω);
def: to settle in alongside, i.e. lodge stealthily

occurrences.text: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
